notes: Sports, and specifically a scored field with two teams inside a rigid perimeter, so space-bounded — the roles, VAR rulings, cards, R6 animations, ball physics and bot intelligence are gameplay systems that never reach the image model or the placement pass, and layout only owes them the pitch they happen on. Full Stadium preset since the prompt asks for a big stadium and the answers pin it to a full national bowl, plus the Field Sport play options because VAR validating goals and awarding free kicks presupposes a goal-mouth scoring plane, a touchline boundary, and restart positions; bleachers ringing a bowl are stepped relief, hence P0 + tiered. The technician substituting players is what earns spectator-zone: benches and dugouts outside the touchline holding inactive players. With no user available I assumed one regulation pitch rather than a training ground alongside it, and no enterable tunnels or dressing rooms, which keeps the build off P3.
